mapper.select:
SELECT t.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_img AS profileImg,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TIP_LIKE tl WHERE tl.tip_id = t.tip_id ) AS like_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TIP_COMMENT tc WHERE tc.tip_id = t.tip_id AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS comment_count
FROM TB_TIP t
LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
